description: View upcoming scheduled posts sorted by date. Returns id+status+scheduledAt by default; use detail='medium' or 'full' for more fields. For a single post use get_post.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

days.description: How many days ahead to show

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: get_calendar
